answers.q1: "dokuwiki": TableFormat with lineabove, linebelowheader, linebetweenrows and linebelow all None; headerrow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "^"), datarow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "|"), padding=0, with_header_hide=None.
answers.q2: README.md (format list, a dokuwiki description section with example, and CLI help text), tabulate/cli.py help text (supported output formats), the tabulate() docstring (format list plus a doctest example), and test/test_output.py (import of tabulate_formats and a registration test).
answers.q3: It replaces each "|" with "%%|%%" and each "^" with "%%^%%" (DokuWiki's no-format escape) in every cell value.
answers.q4: Decimal is treated as right alignment (two spaces before, one after, with value rstripped). None/unknown alignment gets a single space on each side around the stripped value.
answers.q5: Because tabulate already pads cells to column width; keeping that padding would add extra spaces on the aligned side and short cells could accidentally look centered. Only the padding opposite the alignment is kept, so alignment is encoded correctly.
answers.q6: That tabulate([], tablefmt="dokuwiki") returns "" and tabulate([], ["name","qty"], tablefmt="dokuwiki") returns "^ name    ^ qty    ^".
